checks.detail: Round 1 GBDT CV=0.8485 -> Round 2 CV=0.852974 (+0.53%): consistent directional improvement, well below the 20% single-round leakage threshold. CV vs floor (0.8101) relative gap=5.30%, below the 8% alert threshold. No holdout_score separate from OOF (submission-only evaluation), but floor=0.8101 serves as the calibration anchor. Promotion threshold now uses floor_self_reported (same-basis fix from round 1 suggestion resolved by matching floor mode). No regression of holdout vs CV.

checks.detail: GBDT per-fold scores: [0.8715, 0.8596, 0.8371, 0.8427, 0.8539], std=0.0123. Max fold deviation from mean (0.8530): +1.85% / -1.59%. checks.detail: GBDT OOF: 891 rows (full train set), float64 probabilities range [0.028, 0.989], 779 unique values (genuine continuous OOF). Linear OOF: 891 rows, float64 [0.003, 0.990], accuracy=0.832772 matches reported 0.832772 exactly (gap=0.0), target correlation=0.672. Both OOFs confirmed honest out-of-fold predictions.

checks.name: probability_domain_blend
checks.detail: Round-2 fix confirmed: cand_gbdt.csv dtype=float64, 390 unique values in (0,1) -- continuous positive-class probability. cand_linear.csv dtype=float64, 393 unique values -- continuous. checks.name: prediction_sanity
checks.detail: submission.csv: 418 rows (expected 418), 2 unique class labels {0,1}, all finite. Predicted positive rate=0.347, train positive rate=0.384, ratio=0.904 within [0.6, 1.66] band -- no threshold collapse. CV=0.852974 vs floor=0.810 is +5.3% improvement, not near-perfect (threshold >98%) -- no leakage signal from score magnitude. prediction_sanity.json verdict=PASS corroborated on all sub-checks (finite, non_constant, plausible_range, distribution_check, row_count).

checks.name: class_balance_vs_base_rate
checks.detail: Class 1 predicted share=0.347 vs train base rate=0.384; ratio=0.904. Class 0 predicted share=0.653 vs train base rate=0.616; ratio=1.060. Both ratios within [0.6, 1.66] classification-balance band. Model is not threshold-collapsed or systematically miscalibrated. Slight under-prediction of positives (0.037 delta) noted in prediction_sanity.json distribution_check and is within acceptable range.

suggestions.suggestion: Verify tgt_mean_* (5 target-encoded columns) are fitted per fold inside CV to prevent soft leakage. If global encoding is used on all 891 rows before splitting, micro-leakage inflates OOF scores by roughly 0.5-1 point.
suggestions.implementation_hint: In feature_pipeline.py, compute tgt_mean_ aggregates using only cv_folds.json train indices per fold; apply transform to val indices. Do not fit on full dataset pre-split.

suggestions.suggestion: Linear NNLS weight=0.0 in both rounds; consider replacing with calibrated LR (CalibratedClassifierCV) or a tree-based diversity source to produce non-zero blend weight and recover ensemble benefit.
suggestions.implementation_hint: Wrap LinearSpecialist model with sklearn.calibration.CalibratedClassifierCV(cv=5) before predicting; re-export probabilities to cand_linear.csv and re-run NNLS.

notes: Round 2 passes all generalization checks. Round-1 WARN findings resolved: (1) cand_gbdt.csv now carries continuous float probabilities (390 unique values confirmed); (2) promotion threshold source is consistent (floor_self_reported). OOF honesty verified for both families: 891-row canonical 5-fold OOF, recomputed accuracy matches reported exactly, target correlation well below 0.95. Predicted class balance ratio=0.90, within safe band.
